passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow assume role permission across all services
code_block:
EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      RoleName: !If [HasRoleName, !Ref RoleName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2CloudWatchLogsAndSSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsCreateGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsGroupAndStreamMgmt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupNamePrefix}*
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupNamePrefix}*:log-stream:*
              - Sid: SSMParameterRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterPathPrefix}*
              - Sid: KMSDecryptForSSMParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !If
                  - HasKmsKeyArn
                  - - !Sub arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/ssm
                    - !Ref KmsKeyArn
                  - !Sub arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/ssm
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                  StringLike:
                    kms:EncryptionContext:aws:ssm:parameterarn: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterPathPrefix}*
